content:
tvOS 27 is the latest software update for Apple TV 4K, and it’s rolling out now to all users. Here’s what’s new in tvOS 27.

tvOS 27 adds revamped Apple Podcasts app, new Apple Music features, custom text sizes, more

tvOS 27 is now available to install via the Settings app on your Apple TV. The software is compatible with all Apple TV 4K models except the first generation; Apple TV HD is not supported.

Apple’s new tvOS 27 update adds the following features and changes:

Podcasts: Apple Podcasts gets a revamp on tvOS that follows a similar iOS update earlier this year. The new tvOS Podcasts app fully supports Apple’s new video features, making it a great place to watch video podcasts. And there’s a fresh design with sidebar navigation and more.

Software Updates via iPhone: One convenient tvOS 27 change is that you can now update your Apple TV 4K’s software directly from your iPhone. Using iOS 27’s Home app, you’ll be able to install tvOS 27 and subsequent updates without actually booting up your Apple TV.

Apple Music upgrades: Apple Music gets two new features in tvOS 27. AutoMix is coming to Apple TV as a fresh option for song transitions that are more DJ-like and could fit in well at a party. Hi-Res Lossless Audio is another addition, available for users with compatible external speaker outputs.

Larger text sizes: You can now use Dynamic Type in the Settings app to customize the size of text systemwide, letting you make it larger to better suit your needs and viewing setup.

Finally, Apple says that tvOS 27 supports faster AirPlay connections, smoother animations and app launches, and makes Control Center more responsive.

What’s missing: Siri AI and smart downloads

Notably missing from tvOS 27 is the new Siri AI assistant. Only the old Siri is offered. Rumors indicate that’s because a new Apple TV 4K is about to launch with hardware upgrades that can power Siri AI.

Another missing upgrade is a “Smart downloads” feature that Apple mentioned at WWDC. tvOS has never previously supported downloads for TV content, so it was a surprising announcement. It’s possible “Smart downloads” refers to something system-related and doesn’t involves shows and movies. In any case, there’s been no sign of the feature in the tvOS 27 beta.

Have you installed tvOS 27? How is it running for you? Let us know in the comments.
